name: Kurahashi Ikumi
source:
Before change Height:170cm,Weight:62kg

After getting caught in the Ai Mai Mist, Ikumi wakes up in a girl's body. Unable to completely adapt to her new appearance, she talks with the male pronoun 'ore', prefers wearing boy's clothes, and accidentally walks into the boy's bathroom since she has a hard time remembering to act as a girl while experiencing the many new discoveries of the female body. She desires to return back to her original form.
